To achieve Accomplished, resolve critical technical discrepancies: correct Kourou's latitude to ~5.23°N, calculate the semi-major axis accurately (6971 km, not 7171 km), specify the correct retrograde SSO inclination (97.79°), and reconcile the ground pass duration in your text with the STK report's 9.7-minute mean.","C3":"You successfully summarized your design decisions and noted Vega E launcher risks. To achieve Accomplished, move beyond descriptive summaries by critically synthesizing the performance trade-offs, engineering compromises, and technical limitations identified across your STK analyses.","C4":"Your report follows a clear structure with an executive summary. To reach Accomplished, replace raw Wikipedia tables and links with properly formatted, original tables and academic citations. Ensure all figures and tables have numbers and descriptive captions, and proofread thoroughly to fix incomplete sentences, such as the truncated text in your EOL section."}}
